title: Mehbooba seeks service rules for protesting J&K medical college staff

ai.summary: J&K medical college staff have been on strike for a week demanding service rules after seven years of denied career progression and benefits. The government had promised to finalize rules by September 30 but delayed.

facts.claim: non-gazetted employees of J&K’s five new medical colleges have been denied a clear service structure, career progression and legitimate benefits
facts.quote: Mufti said that for nearly seven years, non-gazetted employees of J&K’s five new medical colleges have been denied a clear service structure, career progression and legitimate benefits

facts.claim: employees have been on strike for the past week
facts.quote: Since Monday, the employees of GMCs of Doda, Rajouri, Poonch, Anantnag and Baramulla have been on protest demanding a formally notified service framework for non gazetted employees

facts.claim: government promised to finalize rules by September 30 but delayed
facts.quote: The protesters said that the assurances by the government to finalise the rules by September 30 were not fulfilled prompting them to go for protest

ai.background_note: J&K medical college staff have been striking for service rules after seven years of denied career progression and benefits, with the government failing to meet its September 30 deadline.
